### iliad-149 (23.586–699)

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| τὸν δ’ αὖτ’ Ἀντίλοχος πεπνυμένος ἀντίον ηὔδα (23.586, whole-line reply formula) | "To him in turn prudent Antilochus spoke, face to face:" | "Then prudent Antilochus spoke to him in turn, face to face:" | "answered" (reserved for ἀμείβετο); follows the table's τὴν δ’ αὖτ’ Ἀντήνωρ πεπνυμένος ἀντίον ηὔδα (3.203) with the pronoun changed |
| καί μιν φωνήσας ἔπεα πτερόεντα προσηύδα (23.601, 23.625; departure from 1.201 in the pronoun only) | "and, lifting his voice, to him winged words he spoke:" | "and lifting his voice he spoke winged words to him:" | "to her" (the published English of 1.201, where μιν is Athena; here μιν is Antilochus and Achilles); each line sits inside a longer unit (23.600–601, 23.624–625), so the whole-unit rule does not apply, as at 4.312 |
| ἦ ῥα καί (23.596, 23.612) | "He spoke, and" | "So he said, and" | follows the table's ἦ ῥα καί (23.563) |
| ἀρείων (πρότερος καὶ ἀρείων, 23.588) | "better" | "better" | "braver" (the table's rendering of the same two words at 2.707, where Ajax is compared with Achilles in courage; here Antilochus compares age and standing, so "braver" would narrow it); πρότερος keeps "elder" (2.707) |
| ὑπερβασίαι (23.589) | "oversteppings" | "transgressions" | "insolence", "arrogance" (reserved for ὕβρις); follows the Odyssey's ὑπερβασίη "overstepping" / "transgression" (13.193) |
| κραιπνότερος νόος, λεπτὴ μῆτις (23.590) | "more rushing" mind, "thin" cunning | "more rushing", "thin" | "quicker", "headlong", "slender" (λεπτός "thin" as in 10.226); κραιπνός keeps the table's "rushing", μῆτις "cunning" |
| ἐπιτλήτω κραδίη (23.591) | "let your heart endure" | "let your heart endure it" | "be patient" (avoided) |
| ἄνσχεο (23.587) | "Hold out" | "Bear up" | "Be patient", "Hold back", "Wait"; ἀνέχομαι "endure, put up with" |
| ἰάνθη (θυμὸς ἰάνθη, 23.598, 23.600) | "was warmed" | "was cheered" | "was melted", "was soothed", "was refreshed"; ἰαίνω "warm", the image of dew keeps the English from saying "warmed" in `i` |
| φρίσσουσιν ἄρουραι (23.599) | "the plough-lands bristle" | "the plough-lands bristle" | "shiver", "stand thick with corn"; ἄρουρα "plough-land" as in the table |
| παρήορος (23.603; sense not known here) | "swung-aside" | "one to swing aside" (+ note: sense not known) | "wayward", "flighty", "unsteady" (each picks a guess), "trace-horse" (the harness sense of 16.471, which does not fit a person); built on παρά + ἀείρω |
| παραπείθω (παρέπεισεν, 23.606) | "persuaded over" | "won over" | "talked round" (kept out, as for ἐπιγνάμπτω at 2.14), "deceived" |
| ἐπιπείθομαι (ἐπιπείσομαι, 23.609) | "comply" | "comply" | "obey", "be persuaded" |
| κειμήλιον (23.618) | "treasure" | "treasure" | "keepsake", "heirloom", "possession" (κτέρας "possession", 10.216); from κεῖμαι "lie", a thing laid up |
| τάφος (Πατρόκλοιο τάφου, 23.619; Οἰδιπόδαο ἐς τάφον, 23.680) | "burial" | "burial" | "tomb" (kept for σῆμα, τύμβος), "funeral", "grave"; a different word from the Odyssey's τάφος "amazement" (21.122) |
| αὔτως (23.621) | "just so" | "without more ado" | "for nothing", "freely"; the Odyssey's `i` for αὔτως (14.151), `l` as in the Iliad table |
| κηδεμόνες (23.674) | "the caretakers" | "those who will take care of him" | "those in charge of the burial" (the table's `i` at 23.163, where the dead is buried; here the beaten man is carried off alive), "his kinsmen", "mourners" |
| κτερέϊζε (23.646) | "render funeral rites to" | "pay … funeral honours" | "bury"; follows the table's κτεριοῦσι (11.455) and κτεριῶ (18.334) |
| ἀγασσάμενοι (23.639) | "feeling indignation" | "in indignation" | "in wonder", "begrudging"; the table's ἀγασσάμενοι "feeling indignation" (7.41), the sense chosen from the context |
| ταλαεργός (ἡμίονον ταλαεργόν, 23.654, 23.662, 23.666) | "toil-enduring" | "toil-enduring" | "hard-working", "sturdy", "patient"; τλάω "endure" + ἔργον; the mule, a stock epithet |
| ἄλγιστος (ἥ τ’ ἀλγίστη δαμάσασθαι, 23.655) | "most painful" | "most troublesome" | "hardest", "most difficult"; ἄλγος "pain" in the root, the note says so |
| ἀδμήτην (23.655) | "untamed" | "unbroken" | the table's ἀδμής "untamed" (6.109) and "unbroken" (23.265) |
| πυγμαχίη (23.653, 23.665) | "boxing" | "boxing" | "fist-fighting", "pugilism" |
| ὄρνυτο (23.664) | "rose" | "started up" | "leapt up" (θόρε); as at 23.488 |
| εἰδὼς πυγμαχίης (23.665) | "knowing boxing" | "skilled in boxing" | "expert at", "a master of"; εἰδώς "knowing" + genitive |
| ἀολλέες (23.674) | "together" | "together" | "in a crowd", "in a body"; ἀολλής "all together" |
| δαμέντα (23.675) | "subdued" | "subdued" | "overpowered" (kept for βιησάμενος, 23.576), "beaten" (νικηθείς); δάμνημι "subdue, tame", the same verb-family as δαμάσασθαι at 23.655 |
| Ταλαϊονίδης (23.678) | "Talaion’s descendant" | "a descendant of Talaion" | "Talaus’ son"; the patronymic suffix -ίδης as in Δαρδανίδης "Dardanus’ descendant" |
| δεδουπότος (Οἰδιπόδαο, 23.679) | "having fallen" | "had fallen" (+ note: i.e. had died) | "had died" (names the sense), "was dead"; δουπέω "fall with a thud" |
| ἐνίκα (πάντας ἐνίκα Καδμείωνας, 23.680; imperfect) | "kept prevailing over" | "kept defeating" | "won over", "defeated"; the table's νικάω "prevailed over" / "defeated", with the imperfect shown by "kept" |
| ἀμφεπονεῖτο (23.681) | "busied himself about" | "busied himself about" | "tended", "attended", "fussed over"; ἀμφιπονέομαι "busy oneself around" |
| ἀγραύλοιο (βοὸς ἀγραύλοιο, 23.684) | "field-dwelling" | "of the fields" | "wild", "wandering", "pasture"; ἀγρός "field" + probably αὐλή "dwelling", the note says so |
| ἐϋτμήτους (23.684) | "well-cut" | "well-cut" | "well-tanned", "fine"; ἐΰ + τμητός |
| χρόμαδος γενύων (23.688; rare noun) | "grinding of jaws" | "grinding of jaws" | "gnashing", "crash of teeth"; the word is rare, the note says the English follows the context |
| στιβαρῇσιν (χερσὶ στιβαρῇσιν, 23.686) | "stout" | "stout" | "sturdy", "strong"; the table's στιβαρός "stout" |
| ὑπήριπε (23.691) | "gave way beneath him" | "gave way beneath him" | "collapsed", "fell away"; ὑπο- "under" + ἐρείπω |
| φρικὸς Βορέω (23.692) | "the ripple of the North Wind" | "the North Wind’s ripple" | "shiver", "bristling", "blast" (reserved for ἄελλα); Βορέης "North Wind" as in the table |
| φυκιόεις (23.693) | "weedy" | "weedy" | "seaweedy", "sea-wrack"; from φῦκος "seaweed" |
| ἀμφέσταν (23.695) | "stood around" | "stood around" | "gathered round", "stood by" |
| ἐφελκομένοισι πόδεσσιν (23.696) | "with feet dragging" | "with his feet dragging" | "trailing", "scraping"; ἐφέλκομαι "drag along" |
| κάρη βάλλονθ’ ἑτέρωσε (23.697) | "his head throwing to the other side" | "his head dropping to the other side" | "his head lolling", "his head bobbing"; βάλλω "throw, let drop" |
| ἀλλοφρονέοντα (23.698) | "thinking elsewhere" | "with his thoughts elsewhere" | "senseless", "unconscious", "dazed" (each decides); follows the Odyssey's ἀλλοφρονέων (10.374) |
| κόμισαν (23.699) | "carried away" | "carried away" | "fetched", "collected"; κομίζω "carry off" (2.875) |
